SELECT u.user_id, u.full_name, u.country 
FROM users u 
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id 
WHERE u.user_id IN (
  SELECT t.user_id 
  FROM transactions t 
  JOIN login_events le ON t.user_id = le.user_id 
  WHERE t.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days') 
  GROUP BY t.user_id, le.country 
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT le.country) >= 5 
  AND le.created_at >= date('now', '-30 days')
)

       (COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)) as failure_rate
FROM users u JOIN login_events le ON u.user_id = le.user_id
JOIN transactions t ON u.user_id = t.user_id

GROUP BY le.country
HAVING (COUNT(DISTINCT t.txn_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id)) > 0.1
